summary: On November 9, 2023, Bachelor introduced an Oakland Unified School District resolution calling for a ceasefire, hostage release, and Israeli troop withdrawal from Gaza, saying the board sought "peace over continued bloodshed." CAIR Action endorsed her in the general election. Her early, personal introduction of a ceasefire-and-withdrawal resolution, combined with that endorsement, marks her as a strong champion for Palestinian justice.
